math_review.two_by_two_hermitian_block: For D=[[a,c],[c*,b]], det=ab-|c|^2 and trace=a+b exactly classify signs. Hermitian check guarantees real diagonal; disjoint adjacent blocks are structurally enforced. Positive determinant with zero trace cannot occur for a Hermitian 2x2 block.
math_review.permutation: permutation[i] gives original row index of factor row i; inverse[original_j] maps original column to factor column. Thus streamed residual uses A[permutation,permutation]. L D L* construction correctly conjugates sparse columns.
math_review.residual_norm: All stored real/imaginary components are exact rational values; the row bound sums |Re|+|Im|. The exact residual is Hermitian, so ||E||2 <= sqrt(||E||1 ||E||inf)=||E||inf <= delta.
math_review.bracketing: With B- approximating P(H-eta I)P* and B+ approximating P(H+eta I)P*, exact residual bounds delta±<eta and equal nonzero inertias force exactly m negative roots of H. Ordered Hermitian eigenvalue inequalities give gap>=eta-max(delta-,delta+). An inverse-norm bound is unnecessary for this two-sided argument.
math_review.edge_counts: m=0 and m=n are valid with the corresponding one-sided gap inequality; separately verified at exponents -1000 through +1000.
math_review.no_dense_or_product_in_verifier: Read implementation and reran original monkeypatched tests. Factor provider/test construction may use tiny dense LAPACK or sparse products; verifier itself uses sparse row/column indexes, never a dense original matrix or full sparse factor product.
math_review.input_memory: Entire bounded inputs/factors are converted to rational dictionaries. Only factor-product/residual rows stream. This is not a zero-copy input or industrial memory guarantee.
math_review.result_scope: An endpoint inertia certificate alone does not certify selected candidate eigenvectors, nearest-k target order, cluster multiplicity or complete physical mode coverage.

findings.observation: Original reviewed version checked row fill only after converting the entire row, allowing a low configured row limit to allocate up to n exact entries before refusal.
findings.action: Owner moved guard(row=row) immediately after each nonzero row insertion and retained final guard.
